title: Review of c42's food chain with both kinds dividing (SIEXD): replicated on seed 7 with the predator-free twin and the fuel fork
summary: Fresh seed 7, the claimed command (128x128, 120 frames, --lineage-k 5): prey and predator condensates form from noise and coexist to t=12000 (29 components at the end); prey 15 persistent splits (generation 4, merge/split 0.13), predators 30 persistent splits (generation 3, merge/split 0.26). Matched predator-free twin, same seed: 75 static prey droplets, 2 persistent splits (generation 1), 75 persistent tracks. Fuel fork at t=6000 (drive.py, fed twin alongside): prey 15 -> 0 by t=6100, predators 25 -> 3 by t=6500 and 0 by t=6700; fed twin keeps 12-23 prey and 20-28 predators to t=8000.

observations.S: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=0: white noise over the whole box
observations.I: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=500-12000: discrete prey (cyan) and predator (orange) droplets, rings and arcs; 29 components at t=12000
observations.X: rerun_nopred/seed7/FACTS.md vs rerun/seed7/FACTS.md: without predators 75 static prey droplets, 2 persistent splits, generation 1; with predators prey 15 persistent splits, generation 4, 7-61 prey components; predators engulf prey into rings (sheet t=3100-4700)
observations.D: rerun/seed7/FACTS.md species blocks: prey 15 persistent splits (generation 4), predators 30 (generation 3) at K=5; sheet shows prey dumbbells (t=1000-2100) and predator rings breaking into arcs that round up (t=4100-5700)
observations.E: cut_s7.png/json vs fed_s7: after the fuel fork at t=6000 prey 15 -> 0 by t=6100 and predators 25 -> 0 by t=6700; fed twin 12-23 prey and 20-28 predators at t=6100-8000

seeds_run.result: pass: both kinds divide (prey gen 4, predator gen 3 at K=5), coexist to t=12000; predator-free twin frozen; fuel fork kills both

controls_run.X: rerun_nopred/seed7 (pred_on 0, same seed, grid, duration, lineage window)
controls_run.E: fed_s7 vs cut_s7 (tcut 6000, drive.py from the claim)

verdicts.limitation: E is by construction (prey are made only from fuel and decay; predators only from prey), as the author states. Predator 'division' is a ring around an eaten prey breaking into arcs that round up; daughters are unequal and the body plan cycles droplet -> ring -> arc -> droplet, so it is weaker than prey dumbbell pinching. The lineage window is 500 t (K=5); prey also appear by nucleation from fuel (k0), so some prey births are not divisions. No dt/2 or grid variant; one fresh seed; I did not run a matched Laplacian-only twin.
